data.title: Refusal of permit for a New Year's bonfire on the beach (Ablehnung Brauchtumsfeuer)
data.summary: Amt Musterschlei (Ordnungsamt) refused Tjark Beispielholm's application for a New Year's bonfire on the beach near Knickweg, because the site lies in the "Musterschlei-Ufer" landscape conservation area and nesting birds in the adjacent reeds must not be disturbed. An objection (Widerspruch) may be filed within one month of notification.
data.explanation: The local authority has turned down your request to light a bonfire on that stretch of beach because it is a protected nature area. Instead, you are invited to join the municipality's shared bonfire at the harbour festival ground. If you disagree with the refusal, you may file a written objection (Widerspruch) with Amt Musterschlei, either in writing or recorded in person at the office; the app will show the deadline for this. If you do nothing, the refusal becomes final. No payment is requested in this letter.
